svg.title: Both the teacher and the SFT student receive real page images.
svg.desc: The teacher first reads each real page. Only refinement is text-only. Student SFT still consumes all real candidate images and learns the evidence-and-order target.

g.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, Noto Sans SC, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Both the teacher and the SFT student receive real page images.
Only the teacher’s refinement request is text-only: it condenses analyses already grounded in page images.
A · Prepare SFT targets with the Gemini teacher
US REITs start year? Image 3, labeled relevant
Gemini analyzes the visible page evidence
Repeat per candidate → K page analyses
+ the target order supplied by code
Images are not resent for refinement
Evidence comes from stage 1 image reading
images: all real candidate image paths
The text supplies the learning target
Images remain in the student input
B · Student SFT: Qwen takes the question and all real candidate images
Input: the same question + real candidate images 1–5
Training actually reads and decodes these images
Gold stays out of the prompt; notes do not replace images
The assistant target prepared in A
Per-page teacher analysis prepares supervision. The student still reads images while learning to generate the target.
Thumbnails are the actual candidate pages in saved training order; image 3 is relevant.
K=5: preparing an uncached successful example without retries takes 5 image analyses + 1 text refinement.
